svg.title: Transport network graph construction
svg.desc: Four-stage diagram showing how route vertices, stop nodes, transfer edges, and facility nodes are assembled into the NetworkX graph

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What are route vertex nodes in the transport graph?')
g.text: Each coordinate becomes a graph node

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How are consecutive route vertices connected?')
sendPrompt('How are stop nodes connected to route vertices?')
sendPrompt('How are nearby stops connected for transfers?')
g.text: Stops within 150 m linked by walk

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How are healthcare facilities added to the graph?')
g.text: Walk edges to all stops within 1 km

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the final graph look like?')
